I replied to Ruth in the #strategic-pod thread: Orlavine Medical Supply is at 50 seats.

The 50 comes from Gideon's post in that channel on 14 Oct. He said Moss's 30 Sep digest, which says 55, is wrong, and that he'd asked Moss to fix it. I found no corrected digest, and no Orlavine CRM or contract record that I can see. I told Ruth that, and suggested she confirm with Gideon if the sheet needs to be exact.
